use py:urllib.parse as urls
foreign urls.unquote(Text) -> Text
use net:System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex as Rx
use js:"node:path/posix" as path
use js:semver as sv

unit kb
unit mb = 1024 kb

record ArtifactIn {
    raw_path: Text
    channel: Text
    size_kb: Int
}

record Request {
    min_range: Text
    budget_mb: Float
    artifacts: List[ArtifactIn]
}

record Artifact {
    norm: Text
    pkg: Text
    ver: Text
    channel: Text
    size_kb: Int
    path_ok: Bool
    ver_valid: Bool
    semver_ok: Bool
}

fn valid_channel(ch: Text) -> Bool pure =
    ch == "stable" or ch == "beta" or ch == "lts"

fn size_tier(size: Int) -> Text pure = cases size {
    < 100 => "tiny"
    <= 1000 => "standard"
    <= 5000 => "large"
    else => "oversize"
}

fn fits_budget(used: Float[kb], budget: Float[mb]) -> Bool pure =
    used <= (budget to kb)

fn base_eligible(a: Artifact) -> Bool pure =
    a.path_ok and valid_channel(a.channel) and a.semver_ok and size_tier(a.size_kb) != "oversize"

fn is_lts_exempt(a: Artifact) -> Bool pure = (
    a.path_ok
    and a.channel == "lts"
    and str_contains(a.pkg, "security")
    and a.ver_valid
    and str_contains(a.ver, "-") == false
    and size_tier(a.size_kb) != "oversize"
)

fn is_eligible(a: Artifact) -> Bool pure =
    base_eligible(a) or is_lts_exempt(a)

fn eval_artifact(a: ArtifactIn, min_range: Text) -> Artifact =
    let norm = a.raw_path |> urls.unquote |> path.normalize in
    let ver = path.basename(norm) in
    let pkg = path.dirname(norm) in
    let path_ok = Rx.IsMatch(norm, "^[a-z0-9-]+/[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+(-[a-z0-9.]+)?$") in
    let ver_valid = (sv.valid(ver) ?? "") != "" in
    let semver_ok =
        if ver_valid then
            sv.satisfies(ver, min_range)
        else
            false
    in
    Artifact(
        norm: norm,
        pkg: pkg,
        ver: ver,
        channel: a.channel,
        size_kb: a.size_kb,
        path_ok: path_ok,
        ver_valid: ver_valid,
        semver_ok: semver_ok
    )

let req: Request = from_json(stdin_text())
let items = [eval_artifact(a, req.min_range) for a in req.artifacts]

let summary = summarize a in items {
    total: count
    eligible: count where is_eligible(a)
    oversize: count where size_tier(a.size_kb) == "oversize"
    exempt: count where is_lts_exempt(a) and base_eligible(a) == false
    total_kb: sum a.size_kb
    eligible_kb: sum a.size_kb where is_eligible(a)
    max_kb: max a.size_kb default 0
}

let judged = [record { bad: is_eligible(a) == false } for a in items]
let consecutive_rejects = count adjacent past, now in judged where past.bad and now.bad
let freeze = consecutive_rejects >= 2
let within_budget = fits_budget(to_float(summary.eligible_kb) as kb, req.budget_mb as mb)
let eligible_versions = [a.ver for a in items where is_eligible(a)]
let recommended = sv.maxSatisfying(eligible_versions, ">=0.0.0")

let out = record {
    total: summary.total
    eligible: summary.eligible
    oversize: summary.oversize
    exempt: summary.exempt
    total_kb: summary.total_kb
    eligible_kb: summary.eligible_kb
    max_kb: summary.max_kb
    consecutive_rejects
    freeze
    within_budget
    recommended
}

print json_encode(out)
